def sort_birthdays(records):
    if len(records)<2:return records[:]
    m=len(records)//2;l=sort_birthdays(records[:m]);r=sort_birthdays(records[m:]);out=[];i=j=0
    while i<len(l) and j<len(r):
        if l[i][1]<=r[j][1]:out.append(l[i]);i+=1
        else:out.append(r[j]);j+=1
    return out+l[i:]+r[j:]

steps.text: Check whether the length of records is less than 2. Return records[:].
Set m to len(records) // 2. Set l to sort_birthdays(records[:m]). Set r to sort_birthdays(records[m:]). Set out to an empty list. Set i = j to 0.
Repeat while i is less than the length of l and j is less than the length of r.
Check whether l[i][1] is at most r[j][1]. Append l[i] to out. Increase i by 1.
Append r[j] to out. Increase j by 1.
